_meta.what_this_is: A single query vector and key vector in one 2D rotation plane, plus position pairs to score. RoPE (rotary position embedding) encodes a token's position by ROTATING its query/key vector by an angle proportional to the position. The magic property this fixture is built to expose: the attention score between a query at position m and a key at position n then depends only on the RELATIVE offset n-m, never on the absolute positions -- so the same offset at different absolute positions gives the identical score.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. q and k are hand-picked 2D vectors; theta is the per-step rotation angle; pairs are (m, n) positions chosen so some share an offset and some do not.
_meta.format: q, k (2D vectors); theta (radians per position); pairs [[m, n], ...]
